rows.jyutping: mei6 gau3 faan1 siu2 hok6 ge3 N
rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when describing a child or period before primary-school age.

example.english: By my reckoning, they are still preschool age.
example.traditional: 計落，佢仲未夠返小學嘅年紀。
example.jyutping: gai3 lok6 keoi5 zung6 mei6 gau3 faan1 siu2 hok6 ge3 nin4 gei2

rows.note: Use this concise term especially in established expressions such as education or children relating to the years before primary school.

example.english: Preschool education is very important for young children.
example.traditional: 學前教育對小朋友好重要。
example.jyutping: hok6 cin4 gaau3 juk6 deoi3 siu2 pang4 jau5 hou2 zung6 jiu3
